en: Monochrome printed postcard-style illustration of a narrow European street with tall brick and stone townhouses in ornate Northern Renaissance style. The left building has a richly decorated stepped gable, scrollwork and circular ornaments, with a coat-of-arms–like panel and many small-paned windows with shutters. Below is an arched gateway supported by a column leading into a passage. Adjacent houses have stepped gables and rectangular windows. In the background rises a tower with an onion-shaped dome topped by a spire.
